zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Belleville Township Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 3.91%, with an equalization ratio of 66.1%.
Public education represents 51.8% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 31.8%.
Average residential assessment is $310,670, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,147.2.

equityAnalysis.summary: Belleville Township maintains a consistent residential tax base across its residential zones.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Belleville Township, homeowners pay an average of $12,147.2 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 14.19% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 66.1%, assessed values average ~66.1% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 51.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 31.8%, and Essex County claims 16.4%.
